context.label: Context and opportunity
context.intro: CostaSpanish Academy is the commercial website of a Spanish academy and its main public touchpoint for presenting its learning offer to prospective students.
paragraphs: The website organises an educational offer with different learning formats and needs to explain clearly what the academy provides, who each option is for, and how to take the next step.
Within the project ecosystem, the landing has a focused role: connecting the academy’s positioning with course discovery and the acquisition of interested learners.

strategy.label: Commercial strategy
strategy.intro: The commercial structure turns the learning offer into an understandable journey, with a visible value proposition and clear actions to explore courses or get in touch.
paragraphs: The content presents the learning promise first, followed by the elements needed to make a decision: the academy’s approach, learning formats, courses, and contact paths.

CTAs and forms are part of the acquisition journey. Their role is to shorten the distance between understanding the offer and starting a conversation with the academy, without presenting unmeasured activity as proven conversion.

items.title: Offer clarity
items.body: The hierarchy separates the value proposition, course information, and contact so each block answers a specific visitor question.

items.title: Acquisition journey
items.body: Action points connect offer discovery with forms supported by the project’s data layer.

design.label: Design and user experience
design.intro: The visual direction aims to make an educational brand feel approachable and recognisable without losing commercial hierarchy or ease of reading.
paragraphs: The interface combines an expressive brand identity with high-contrast headings, generous content blocks, and calls to action that are easy to locate. The composition keeps brand personality from competing with the core information.

Desktop and mobile reorganise the same narrative rather than simply shrinking it. Navigation, course cards, contact details, and forms adapt to preserve context and comfortable touch targets on smaller screens.

items.title: Hierarchy
items.body: Core messages, the offer, and actions maintain distinct visual levels to support quick scanning.

items.title: Responsive system
items.body: The experience preserves readability, rhythm, and access to actions across desktop and mobile.

seo.label: SEO and organic growth
seo.intro: The website includes a technical SEO foundation and bilingual content; organic work is documented here without attributing rankings, traffic, or outcomes that are not yet supported by published data.
paragraphs: The delivered scope covers the technical preparation of an indexable public website and a content structure that can evolve alongside the academy’s offer.

The next level of this chapter will require specific evidence: keyword research, search intent, content architecture, indexation, performance, and measured outcomes. That deeper work is explicitly still evolving.

items.title: Documented foundation
items.body: Technical SEO and content in Spanish and English are part of the website’s current capabilities.

items.title: Future deep dive
items.body: The organic strategy and its outcomes will only be expanded when verifiable evidence exists for each decision and metric.

development.label: Development and implementation
development.intro: The implementation combines Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with internationalisation and a data layer that supports the commercial experience.
paragraphs: Components and responsive behaviour maintain a consistent experience across pages and screen sizes without duplicating the main structure.
Bilingual content is integrated through i18n and forms connect to MongoDB, so acquisition is not reduced to a static interface.

items.title: Public experience
items.body: Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS support the composition, responsive adaptation, and continued frontend evolution.

items.title: Content and data
items.body: Internationalisation maintains the bilingual experience while MongoDB supports data-connected form flows.

results.label: Delivered outcome
results.intro: The verifiable outcome is a bilingual commercial website in production, prepared to present the offer, capture enquiries, and evolve with the academy’s needs.
paragraphs: The delivery brings together the value proposition, courses, contact paths, and data-connected forms in one responsive experience.
This case study does not attribute conversion percentages, traffic growth, rankings, or Core Web Vitals because the repository does not currently provide reliable measurement to support those claims.

items.title: Current status
items.body: The website is live and continues to serve as CostaSpanish Academy’s commercial presence.

items.title: Delivered capabilities
items.body: Responsive experience, bilingual content, technical SEO, and forms connected to the database.

evolution.label: Evolution
evolution.intro: The website remains in production and continues to evolve alongside CostaSpanish Academy’s commercial needs.
paragraphs: Future improvements can refine content, acquisition journeys, and SEO documentation as new evidence and usage data become available.

Within the ecosystem, the website retains its role as the public commercial layer while CostaSpanish LMS develops the operational and academic side. They are related products with distinct responsibilities.

items.title: In evolution
items.body: Content, experience, and organic strategy refinements tied to real business needs.

items.title: Documented evolution
items.body: The earlier direction and current redesign are now connected through real evidence preserved in the project history.

product.label: Product and vision
product.intro: CostaSpanish LMS is the academy’s internal platform for centralising academic operations and turning fragmented processes into a connected product.
paragraphs: The system is designed first for teachers and administrators. It brings together the context required to manage learners, courses, classes, vouchers, resources, and rules without relying on several disconnected tools.

The MVP is already used in day-to-day operations and continues to evolve. The vision is not to accumulate features, but to build a dependable foundation for preparing, delivering, and recording each learning experience.

items.title: Operational layer
items.body: It organises the academy’s daily work and keeps decisions about learners, classes, and consumption connected.

items.title: Product direction
items.body: It is moving towards a richer learning experience without presenting the public and learner-facing layers still in progress as finished.

problem.label: Problem and real-world needs
problem.intro: The challenge was not digitising a spreadsheet; it was keeping people, the learning offer, sessions, and usage rights consistent.
paragraphs: When learners, schedules, materials, vouchers, and follow-up live in separate tools, a simple action can require several manual checks. That fragmentation increases administrative work and makes contradictory data more likely.

The product had to represent real rules: who can attend, which plan is active, how a credit is consumed, what changes when a class is recorded, and which information the teacher needs to continue the process.

items.title: Fragmented context
items.body: Operational information loses value when courses, learners, resources, and sessions do not share the same context.

items.title: Rules with consequences
items.body: Attendance, enrolment, vouchers, and credits change business state and cannot rely on UI decisions alone.

items.title: Teaching continuity
items.body: Each lesson needs goals, history, and resources so preparation does not restart from zero.

modules.label: Core modules
modules.intro: The platform is divided into domains the business can understand, while each domain is designed to collaborate in workflows that span the operation.
paragraphs: Modularity allows one capability to evolve without turning every screen into an exception. Boundaries follow the language of the product and make relationships between academic management, consumption, and administration explicit.

items.title: Learners
items.body: Identity, academic profile, and the context needed to connect each learner with courses, plans, and classes.

items.title: Courses
items.body: Definition of the learning offer and configuration of learning experiences; course profiles continue to gain depth.

items.title: Lessons and schedules
items.body: Planning, session records, attendance, and continuity between what was prepared and what was delivered.

items.title: Vouchers and entitlements
items.body: Plans, credits, and consumption policies that determine what each learner can use and under which conditions.

items.title: Resources
items.body: Teaching materials organised so they can be found, reused, and connected to academic work.

items.title: Administration
items.body: Roles, finance, and internal tools for operating the service with one shared view of system state.

flows.label: User flows
flows.intro: Value appears when modules stop acting as islands and a decision retains its meaning throughout the journey.
paragraphs: These flows summarise three representative journeys. They do not describe every screen; they show how the product preserves context and applies rules as state changes.

flows.title: Learning lifecycle
flows.body: Connects learner onboarding with the delivered session and its operational effect.

flows.title: Voucher management
flows.body: Turns an administrative assignment into a validated, traceable entitlement.

flows.title: Lesson preparation
flows.body: Brings together the academic context a teacher needs before and after a session.

architecture.label: System architecture
architecture.intro: The architecture keeps the React experience responsive while placing business authority at server-side boundaries where rules can be applied consistently.
paragraphs: Next.js provides both the product interface and server layer. Critical operations pass through validation, authorisation, and domain services before changing state persisted in MongoDB through Mongoose.

This structure separates what the interface requests from what the system permits. It also keeps integrations and storage behind defined contracts, preventing external details from dictating the product model.

items.title: Next.js and React
items.body: A full-stack foundation for composing the experience and running server-side logic close to each use case.

items.title: MongoDB and Mongoose
items.body: Document persistence with models that express domain relationships, states, and validation.

items.title: NextAuth and roles
items.body: Authentication and access control ensure each operation is evaluated with the correct identity and permissions.

items.title: Zod and explicit boundaries
items.body: Input validation prevents incomplete or ambiguous data from reaching critical rules.

items.title: Storage and internationalisation
items.body: Firebase Storage and ES/EN content are integrated as system capabilities rather than scattered component logic.

domainModeling.label: Domain modelling
domainModeling.intro: The model separates identity, academic context, course definitions, and operational events so one entity does not have to explain the whole product.
paragraphs: A user identifies and authenticates; a learner profile holds academic information. Likewise, a reusable course definition is not the same as the concrete configuration applied to a group or learner.

A lesson acts as an operational event, connecting planning, participants, attendance, resources, and consumption consequences. Active plans and entitlements provide the context required to decide whether that operation is valid.

items.title: User
items.body: Identity, access, and role; it does not absorb all of a learner’s academic context.

items.title: StudentProfile
items.body: Represents the academic dimension and allows it to evolve independently from authentication.

items.title: CourseTemplate and CourseProfile
items.body: Separate a reusable definition from the configuration that adapts a course to a particular experience.

items.title: Lesson
items.body: Materialises teaching work and connects planning, state, attendance, and follow-up.

items.title: Plans and entitlements
items.body: Express active rights, limits, and policies without spreading the same rule across several screens.

engineeringDecisions.label: Engineering decisions
engineeringDecisions.intro: The most valuable decisions sit where a convenient implementation could have compromised product consistency.
paragraphs: Technical evolution has focused on reducing duplicated authority and turning implicit rules into canonical paths that can be tested, reviewed, and reused.

items.title: Server-side authority
items.body: The client expresses intent; the server rebuilds context, authorises the request, and decides the valid change.

items.title: Enrolment integrity
items.body: A valid enrolment must keep course, learner, and associated entitlements aligned even when several steps are involved.

items.title: Canonical builders
items.body: Plan and entitlement creation is centralised so separate flows cannot produce divergent structures.

items.title: Explicit DTOs and ordering
items.body: Relevant boundaries receive deliberate data and keep the order of side-effecting operations predictable.

items.title: Policies as domain
items.body: Consumption, attendance, and plan types are modelled as configurable rules rather than scattered conditionals.

qualityIntegrity.label: Quality and integrity
qualityIntegrity.intro: In this product, an integrity failure is not only a technical defect; it can change credits, attendance, or a learner’s access to training.
paragraphs: The testing strategy first protects rules with consequences: enrolment, entitlement construction, authoritative writes, and transitions involving multiple entities. Full suites then verify that those guarantees continue to work with the rest of the system.

Concurrency scenarios required assumptions to be tested under conditions closer to production, including replica-set support when an operation needed it. Integrity gates run before migrations or changes capable of amplifying inconsistent data.

items.title: Focused tests
items.body: Small, explicit cases isolate the rule being protected and make domain regressions easier to identify.

items.title: Regression suites
items.body: Full validation checks that a local improvement does not break journeys sharing models or services.

items.title: Concurrency
items.body: Sensitive operations are tested with simultaneous writes in mind, not only the ideal sequential path.

items.title: Change gates
items.body: Pre-flight checks prevent migrations or transformations from running on state that already violates invariants.

roadmap.label: Current status and roadmap
roadmap.intro: The product combines an operational foundation already used by the academy with modules that continue to grow iteratively.
paragraphs: The current layer covers authentication and roles, learner management, classes, vouchers or credits, resources, and administrative tools connected by shared rules.

Evolution is focused on deeper course profiles, lesson preparation and notes, the teaching toolbox, storefront, trial calendar, and further integrations. Each addition must preserve the same authority and integrity guarantees.

items.title: Operational now
items.body: An MVP used in day-to-day work, with the main internal domains and a technical foundation ready to grow.

items.title: In evolution
items.body: Greater pedagogical depth, automation, and public interaction without presenting roadmap work as delivered functionality.

lessons.label: Lessons learned
lessons.intro: The central lesson has been to treat operational rules as product and domain concerns, not as details scattered through the interface.
paragraphs: As the LMS grows, maintainability depends less on adding layers and more on choosing one authority, removing duplicate paths, and making the invariants the business needs visible.

items.title: Simple actions still form a domain
items.body: Recording a class or assigning a voucher looks straightforward until states, permissions, and related consequences appear.

items.title: One construction path
items.body: Duplicating critical object creation produces hard-to-detect variations; canonical builders reduce that drift.

items.title: Tests protect decisions
items.body: A useful test does more than verify a function: it preserves the business rule as models and journeys change.

items.title: The model evolves with the product
items.body: Separating related concepts allows capabilities to grow without turning initial entities into ambiguous containers.
